title: Uncertainty-Aware Continual Learning for 2D XRD Interpretation Using Simulated and Experimental Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.17547v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous experimentation systems require characterization models that can interpret heterogeneous measurements and maintain predictive performance as data accumulate. Developing such models involves addressing domain mismatch between data sources, overconfident predictions on unfamiliar inputs, and catastrophic forgetting during sequential updates. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept framework for uncertainty-aware continual interpretation of two-dimensional X-ray diffraction (XRD) data. The framework integrates established components: maximum mean discrepancy-based domain adaptation to reduce simulation-to-experiment discrepancies, a convolutional neural network with a spectral-normalized neural Gaussian process (CNN--SNGP) for predictive uncertainty estimation, and replay with knowledge distillation for sequential model updating. translated_title: 基于模拟与实验数据的面向二维X射线衍射（XRD）解释的不确定性感知持续学习
translated_abstract: 自主实验系统需要能够解释异构测量数据，并随着数据积累保持预测性能的表征模型。开发此类模型需要解决数据源之间的领域不匹配、对陌生输入的过度自信预测，以及顺序更新过程中的灾难性遗忘等问题。在本工作中，我们提出了一个用于二维X射线衍射（XRD）数据不确定性感知持续解释的概念验证框架。该框架集成了多个成熟的组件：基于最大均值差异（MMD）的领域自适应方法，用于减小模拟数据与实验数据之间的差异；采用谱归一化神经高斯过程的卷积神经网络（CNN-SNGP），用于预测不确定性估计；以及结合知识蒸馏的重放机制，用于模型的顺序更新。我们使用模拟数据和先前收集的晶体……（摘要原文在此处被截断）实验数据对该框架进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个不确定性感知的持续学习概念验证框架，通过融合基于MMD的领域自适应、CNN-SNGP不确定性估计以及结合知识蒸馏的重放机制，实现二维XRD数据在模拟与实验域之间稳健且可持续更新的解释。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a proof-of-concept uncertainty-aware continual learning framework for 2D XRD interpretation that integrates MMD-based domain adaptation, CNN-SNGP predictive uncertainty estimation, and replay with knowledge distillation for robust sequential model updating.
